messages:
IncidentBot: HEADS UP: We are tracking an auth ingress failure impacting hosted API requests routed through us-east. Symptoms: intermittent 401s and 502s for token-validated routes. More details: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2162501234 :rotating_light:

Alice W: Observed spike at 16:03 UTC, error rate ~18% for /v1/generate. Token introspection calls to auth-proxy are timing out.

Ben K: Rolling emergency config to bypass token introspection for cached tokens as a short-term mitigation (auth-proxy-v2 fallback). Rolling in us-east-1 edge pool now.

Carol S: Support team notified customers with active sessions in affected regions. Templated note posted to support portal and scaled CS rota. Link to customer comm draft: https://internal.redwood.ai/comm-drafts/ingress-auth-2162501234

Dmitri V: Root cause looks like an upstream rate limit change from the token-issuer service + client retry storm. We've implemented a small circuit breaker and are rate-limiting introspection requests. Telemetry shows error rate dropping.

Alice W: Current status: mitigation applied to ~60% of traffic in us-east, error rate down to ~3%. Still monitoring for regressions. If you see traffic not hitting fallback, ping me.

Support Ops: Customer-impact summary posted to the incident doc and status page. Non-critical customers may see brief 401s, enterprise customers with pinned tokens unaffected.

Ben K: Commands used for the rollout (for ops reference):
```bash
kubectl -n edge rollout restart deploy/ingress-auth-proxy-v2 --selector=region=us-east
# update feature flag: enable_token_introspection_fallback=true
```

Dmitri V: Next steps: 1) complete full us-east rollout (ETA 12m), 2) coordinate with token-issuer team to remove the upstream rate limit change, 3) prepare postmortem template.

Alice W: Postmortem and RCA will be published to #postmortems and linked from status page when ready. If you have customers to prioritize for outreach, add them to the incident doc.

IncidentBot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2162501234. Please avoid non-essential restarts during the rollout window. :white_check_mark:
